A DeepSeek Harness plugin for installing and managing skills by global or workspace scope.

Manage which models appear in the composer model menu. A settings page lists every provider's models with a per-model switch, provider-level show/hide, collapsible groups and filters by kind; switched-off models leave the menu while the model in use in the current session stays. The list can be searched by name or ID and filtered by capability (multimodal, reasoning) and by minimum context window (128K / 256K / 512K / 1M). Rows show the model kind, and chat models also show reasoning support with the adapter's effort levels, their context window and input modalities. Labels merge manual overrides, the settings document, the adapter, the relay's GET /models response, a built-in pi-ai / models.dev catalog, name inference and vendor corrections in that priority order, with the source named on hover and dashed borders marking inferred values. Any model can be edited by hand (kind, context window, modalities, effort levels); those edits are stored outside the profile and can be written back into the model provider's settings. A hard re-fetch drops every cache and asks the adapter and all relays again. A switch, on by default, lets relay routes whose models declare text-only input accept images in memory, without editing configuration files. The hidden list is stored in the profile patch and mirrored to $DSH_HOME.
description.zh: 管理哪些模型出现在输入框的模型菜单里。设置页按 Provider 列出模型，支持逐模型开关、渠道级批量显隐、整组折叠和按类型筛选；关闭的模型从菜单中消失，当前会话正在使用的模型保留。还能按名称 / ID 搜索，按能力（多模态、支持推理）和上下文下限（128K / 256K / 512K / 1M）过滤。每行标注模型类型，对话模型另外标注是否支持推理、适配器公布的思考强度档位、上下文窗口和输入模态。标签按优先级合并手动覆盖、设置文档、适配器、中转站 GET /models 响应、内置 pi-ai / models.dev 目录、模型名推断和厂商校正，悬停显示来源，虚线边框表示推断值。任意模型都可以手动指定类型、上下文窗口、输入模态和思考强度档位；这些覆盖不写 profile 补丁，并且可以写回模型提供商的设置。工具栏的「重新获取能力」会让全部缓存作废并重新询问适配器与所有中转站。一个默认开启的开关让声明纯文本输入的中转站模型真正能接收图片，只在内存里生效，不改配置文件。隐藏列表保存在 profile patch 中，并镜像到 $DSH_HOME。

On and shared by default; /context-graph off and unshare opt a chat out, and stats, build, map and find inspect it.

Full-text search of all local sessions: sessiongraph finds conversations in any workspace, Chinese two-character terms included; sessiongraph_index builds it.

description.en: 「对话管理」全局面板页（浏览器半）：会话与统计两层 Tabs——会话视图给出全量会话（含已归档）的搜索、分页、归档 / 取消归档 / 导出 / 删除、导入为新会话与整理数据（孤儿回收 + 统计重算），统计视图给出全部对话的 token 用量。
A core-only meta-bundle for the DSH personal assistant policy, memory, Wiki, and automations plugins.

Honor of Kings inspired theme for DeepSeek Harness: the Jing · Blazing Sunlight key art is inlined and painted into the window backdrop and both main panels, over an ink night sky with a molten gold sun, frosted mirror shards, drifting embers and a three-level motion switch (full / calm / off). Colours come from overridden design tokens, so panels, bubbles, menus and code blocks follow the theme.
description.zh: 王者荣耀「镜 · 炽阳神光」主题：主视觉内联进插件，同时作为整窗底图与两个主面板的肌理；底子仍是墨色夜空、熔金日轮与光冕、磨砂镜片与飘浮金烬，左下角「镜」徽记可在 神光 / 静谧 / 关闭 三档动效间切换。配色通过覆写设计令牌实现，面板、气泡、菜单与代码块一并跟随。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自定义壁纸插件：在设置面板里选本机图片当背景，可调不透明度/模糊/界面通透度/压暗，即时预览。A DeepSeek Harness Web wallpaper plugin with a dedicated Settings section.

Adds an /if slash command to DSH: the first line is a condition and the remaining lines are an instruction. A fork subagent that inherits the session tools, system prompt and message history judges the condition and answers YES or NO, and only on YES is the instruction sent to the main agent as an ordinary user message, while a NO sends nothing. The condition, judge prompt and verdict never enter the main transcript. While the agent is busy the command queues with ordinary messages, editable, removable and steerable from the queue panel, and a setting switches to the 0.2.x background mode. The judge runs read-only, and falls back to a one-shot model call over a plain transcript when the host has no context-inheriting fork provider. Supports DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 and later (verified on 0.2.1-rc.5 and 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20.3 or later.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 /if 斜杠命令：第一行是条件，其余行是指令。由继承当前会话工具、system prompt 与消息历史的 fork 子代理判断条件并回答 YES 或 NO，只有 YES 才把指令作为一条普通用户消息发给主 agent，NO 则什么都不发送；条件、判断用的 prompt 与判断结果都不会写进主会话。模型工作时命令与普通消息一起排队，可在队列面板里编辑、删除、插话，设置里可切回 0.2.x 的后台模式。判断以只读方式运行，宿主没有可继承上下文的 fork provider 时回退为一次性模型调用加纯文本记录。适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上（已在 0.2.1-rc.5 与 0.2.2-rc.1 验证），需 Node.js 20.3 或更新版本。

description.en: Cross-session memory for your dsh agent: remembered, recalled, and re-verified instead of assumed.
网文写作工作台完整版（含可选嵌入提供方）
Independent, bounded task acceptance verification with durable contracts and receipts.
Branch-aware code knowledge graph for DSH - callers, impact, trace and architecture over 158+ languages, freshness-gated, one dispatcher tool, zero MCP sessions.
description.zh: DSH 原生分支感知代码知识图谱：调用链/影响面/路径/架构覆盖 158+ 语言，保鲜门控，切分支索引自动跟随，单工具分发零 MCP 会话。

description.en: Connects the Google Stitch MCP endpoint as 16 native `mcp__stitch__*` tools for projects, screens and design systems, plus an in-panel card for an API key or OAuth access token.
description.zh: 把 Google Stitch 的 MCP 端点接成 16 个原生 `mcp__stitch__*` 工具，覆盖项目、界面与设计系统，并附一张面板内的 API Key / OAuth 令牌凭据卡片。

description.en: Purge DSH sessions for good and manage them from one console: per-session deletion, a filterable bulk console, and housekeeping sweeps.
description.zh: 彻底删除 DSH 会话，并在一个控制台里集中管理：单条删除、可筛选的批量清理与维护清扫。

description.en: Per-session clock injection with durable idle-gap tracking: tells the agent how long it has been since this particular conversation last spoke, which the host's time context (last message only) cannot.
description.zh: 给指定会话授时，并给出「距上次对话过去多久」。补上宿主时间上下文只算「距上一条消息」、无法按会话开关的缺口。

description.en: The cyber-elixir of youth for the desktop client: fixes the `desktop welcome: Web authentication failed` (HTTP 431) launch failure — an Electron random-port launch lets `dsh-auth-*` login cookies pile up per port (70+ of them, ~229 B each), the startup request headers blow past Node's default 16 KB cap, and the client can no longer launch. Two fixes in one: a scriptable cleaner that removes leftover login cookies from the cookie database (Chromium SQLite) — explicit, offline, keeps a `.bak` copy, `--expired-only` narrows the scope — and a `patch` feature on the settings panel that fixes the launch port through the profile `cordis.patch.yml`, so the client always starts from a single port and cookies stop accumulating across different ones (rewrite `port` as a `!!js` expression to keep the `--port` flag in charge; a per-profile snapshot makes one click revert it). Read the README for usage. Interface, CLI output and market metadata in 9 languages. The purge runs from the bundled CLI (`dsh-cookie-cleaner --clean`) only while the client is fully closed; the in-app half is read-only. npm: `dsh-cookie-cleaner`.
description.zh: 桌面客户端的赛博端粒不老药：解决启动报 `desktop welcome: Web authentication failed`（HTTP 431）的现象——Electron 随机端口启动，`dsh-auth-*` 登录 cookie 随端口越积越多（70 余条、单条约 229 B），启动请求头撑爆 Node 默认 16 KB 上限，客户端直接起不来。两味药：脚本化清理器——报告并清理 cookie 库（Chromium SQLite）里残留的登录凭据，显式、离线、保留 `.bak` 副本，`--expired-only` 可收窄范围；设置面 patch 功能——经由 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 把启动端口固定化，保证客户端始终从单一端口启动，cookie 不再随不同端口累计（`port` 改写成 `!!js` 表达式可让 `--port` 旗标继续优先，按 profile 留快照、点一次即可回滚）。用法详见 README。界面、CLI 输出与市场元数据覆盖 9 语。清理需在客户端完全退出后运行包内 CLI（`dsh-cookie-cleaner --clean`），插件本体只读。npm 包名：`dsh-cookie-cleaner`。

description.en: Groups the sidebar's panel rows: two stay pinned, the rest fold under a collapsible Tools row, and rows can be dragged between the two groups.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板分组：两行常驻，其余收进可折叠的「工具」组，支持拖动互相搬运。

description.en: Computer Use for every DSH session: screen capture, mouse and keyboard, app launch, plan and skill replay, an audit log, guards for dangerous actions, a background code agent, and an OCR workflow (text and coordinates) for apps whose accessibility tree is empty. Verified on macOS only: Windows has a basic GUI backend that is unverified, Linux has no desktop backend (calls fail with unsupported_platform), and the window/AX/browser/clipboard tools register on macOS only.
description.zh: 装一次、所有 DSH 会话可用的 Computer Use 插件：截屏、鼠标键盘、启动应用、计划与技能回放、审计日志、危险动作守卫、后台代码代理，以及面向无障碍树缺失应用的 OCR 工作流（文字与坐标）。仅 macOS 已验证：Windows 只有未验证的基础 GUI 后端，Linux 没有桌面后端（调用报 unsupported_platform），窗口/AX/浏览器/剪贴板工具只在 macOS 注册。

description.en: Manages the lifecycle of the local UM GenAI proxy (127.0.0.1:8788) that DSH's um-genai provider talks to: wakes it on demand for llm/stream calls, stops it after an idle period, and reports health plus a read-only status endpoint. Also ships a DSH settings page for port, always-on mode, idle minutes, interpreter and paths, plus the UM account and proxy API key, and a button that writes the providers.um-genai entry into the profile patch and fills in its model list, since a fresh profile has no provider and the model picker would otherwise stay empty. A renewal watchdog logs in to the campus gateway on a hidden Windows desktop when the upstream token expires. The proxy itself is um_opencode_setup.py, a single-file tool distributed by the University of Macau; a copy is vendored in vendor/ so a fresh install works out of the box, while a copy in ~/.um-opencode/ takes precedence when present. The plugin still does not produce tokens: those come from logging in to the campus gateway. Requires Windows (process discovery and idle shutdown use netstat/taskkill; renewal uses PowerShell and a hidden desktop), Python 3.10+ and a University of Macau account.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 的 um-genai provider 所連的本機 UM GenAI 反代（127.0.0.1:8788）的生命週期：llm/stream 請求進來時按需喚醒、閒置一段時間後關閉、提供健康檢查與唯讀狀態端點。另附 DSH 設定頁（埠號、常駐模式、閒置分鐘、解譯器與路徑、UM 帳號、代理金鑰），以及一顆按鈕：把 providers.um-genai 寫進 profile patch 並補上模型清單（全新 profile 沒有這段設定，模型選單本來會是空的）。續期看門狗在上游 token 過期時於隱藏 Windows 桌面完成校園 gateway 登入。反代本體是 um_opencode_setup.py（澳門大學校內發放的單檔工具），外掛在 vendor/ 自帶一份讓全新安裝即可運作，而 ~/.um-opencode/ 那份優先；它仍然不產生 token，token 由登入校園 gateway 取得。需要 Windows（進程發現與閒置關閉依賴 netstat/taskkill，續期依賴 PowerShell 與隱藏桌面）、Python 3.10+ 與澳門大學帳號。

description.en: A session auto-compaction plugin that is friendly to local models: compaction never makes the local engine re-read history, saving a lot of time; the trigger point and the saved content of the compacted session are user-configurable. After installing, point the agent preset's compaction-basic slot at dsh-auto-compaction-engine (or save the settings page to switch it); until then compaction stays native.
description.zh: 对本地模型友好的会话自动压缩插件：压缩时不会触发本地模型重读历史，节省大量时间；压缩触发点与压缩会话的保存内容可由用户自定义。安装后需把 Agent 预设的 compaction-basic 槽位指向 dsh-auto-compaction-engine（或在设置页保存一次切换）；在此之前仍走原生压缩。

description.en: Neutral warm Chobits Chii picture-book skin for the DSH web UI, with light and dark token sets, a polaroid photo wall, and a built-in Live2D Chii mascot with gaze following.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的小叽绘本风皮肤：明暗双 token、拍立得照片墙，以及内置 Live2D 小叽桌宠（视线跟随）。

description.en: Chat memory that archives messages by time and recalls by stated period, widening twice before admitting it forgot.
description.zh: 按时间归档聊天，用户提到某段时间就先检索，未命中扩大两次，仍没有就如实说「我忘记了」。

description.en: FOFA cyberspace mapping inside the conversation: check the account quota, run FOFA queries and export the full result set into CSV/JSON/TXT files in the session workspace by paging through a time cursor. A CSV or TXT export stopped by its time budget or by an upstream error continues into the same file from the saved cursor, so rows already fetched are kept. Results render as conversation cards (query, match count, file path), and the API key is saved from the plugin page into the Harness credential store.
description.zh: 在对话里做 FOFA 网络空间测绘：查看账号额度、执行查询语句，并把全量结果按时间游标深翻页导出为 CSV／JSON／TXT 落到会话工作区；被时间预算或上游报错中断的 CSV／TXT 导出可凭游标续写同一文件，已拉取的行不丢。结果以对话卡片展示（语句、命中数、文件路径），API Key 在插件页保存到 Harness 凭据库。

description.en: Animated personal assistant with independent chats, shared conversation memory, natural-language reminders and background tasks.
description.zh: 带动态表情的个人助手，提供独立聊天、跨聊天记忆、自然语言提醒和后台任务。

description.en: macOS 14.2+ only: the macOS counterpart to Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail — the DSH conversation rail pulses with whatever the Mac is playing, a real 12-band spectrum that only changes bar length, leaving the host state colours and lengths untouched. Requires the Audio Recording permission on first run. Do not install it alongside dsh-audio-rail: both drive the same rail and register the same /audio-rail/events and /audio-rail/status routes.
description.zh: macOS 14.2+ 专享：Lingwuxin/dsh-audio-rail 的 macOS 对应版，让 DSH 会话页右侧的锚点跟着 Mac 播放的音乐律动，12 段真实频谱只改长度，不覆盖宿主的状态颜色与长度。首次运行需授予「音频录制」权限；请勿与 dsh-audio-rail 同装——两者驱动同一处锚点并注册相同的 /audio-rail/events 与 /audio-rail/status 路由。

description.en: Adds two enhancements to DSH ask_user_question choice cards: right-clicking an option expands a per-option note that is merged into the submitted custom answer, and a footer field asks a side question answered by a fork subagent from the session context, read-only, with no write-back. Keeps left-click, skip, paging and the countdown working as before, and only claims generic choice cards, not plan review or approval cards. Supports DSH 0.2.x from 0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.2-rc.1) and Node.js 20+. Derived from buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note (MIT) and inspired by MichengAI/dsh-btw (Apache-2.0); do not install it together with dsh-question-note — both take over the same ask_user_question card.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 ask_user_question 选择题卡片增加两项能力：右键选项展开补充说明，并合并进提交的 custom 答案；卡片底部可以先问一句，由 fork 子代理带着当前会话上下文只读作答，不改写会话。左键选择、跳过、分页与倒计时照旧，且只接管普通选择题卡片，不接管计划确认与审批卡片。适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及以上的 0.2.x（已在 0.2.2-rc.1 验证），需 Node.js 20+。由 buaaflyaway/dsh-question-note（MIT）派生、并受 MichengAI/dsh-btw（Apache-2.0）启发；不要与 dsh-question-note 同装——两者会接管同一张 ask_user_question 卡片。

description.en: IM stand-in seat for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar panel polls Feishu/Lark, WeCom and DingTalk (switched on from the panel) through the platform CLI you are already logged in to, and wakes the DSH session you bound when a new message arrives, so that session reads it and replies as you — drafts are shown to you first unless you have explicitly allowed sending without confirmation. Groups are polled only after you add them to the watch list, and by default only @-mentions wake the agent; blocked chats are never fetched, message bodies stay in a local state file, and the plugin opens no port of its own.
description.zh: 把「替你值守 IM」做成 DSH 侧边栏的常驻席位：复用本机已登录的飞书/Lark、企业微信、钉钉（需在面板里先启用）CLI 按节奏拉取会话，新消息进来就唤醒你绑定的 DSH 会话，由它读上下文、以你本人的语气起草回复；默认先把草稿给你看，你明确说全自动才直接发出。群要你加进值守名单才开始轮询，且默认只有 @你 的消息唤醒 agent；屏蔽的会话永不拉取，消息正文只留在本机状态文件里，插件不开任何端口。

description.en: Adds a Chat/Work switch in the DSH Desktop titlebar: Chat embeds the DeepSeek web chat (chat.deepseek.com) in a native webview with no DSH API calls from the plugin and is the default on first launch, Work keeps the native agent UI, the page stays mounted across switches, and a confirm-first dialog can copy chat text into a work-mode draft without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 桌面版标题栏加入聊天/工作切换：聊天模式用原生 webview 内嵌 DeepSeek 网页版（chat.deepseek.com），插件自身不调用 DSH API，首次启动默认进入聊天；工作模式保留原生 Agent 界面，切换时网页保持挂载；「带入工作」对话框需先确认，只会填入工作模式草稿、不自动发送。

description.en: Reason tree: breaks a conclusion into a bottom-up argument tree, marks each branch as holds, fails or open, and jumps to the source file in Hippocampus.
description.zh: 根源追溯：把结论拆成从下往上的论证树，每一支可标成立、不成立或待拆，并能跳到海马体看原文。

description.en: Parse PDF/DOCX/HTML resume documents and synchronize them to a user-authorized BOSS Zhipin online resume through Microsoft Edge. Codex, Claude Code, and DSH adapters included.
description.zh: 上传 PDF、DOCX 等简历，自动解析并同步到 BOSS 直聘在线简历，省去手动填写。

description.en: mcore · 自我拟合进化的本地 AI 内核框架（原本名 DHC / DeepSeek Harness Core）：人格核心 + 三层记忆 + 时间轴推演，all-local 隐私可控的 DeepSeek Harness 插件 / Self-fitting local AI core engine for DeepSeek Harness — persona core, three-tier memory, timeline reasoning, all-local by design.
DSH Agent 的会话团队，super agent平替。
DSH 的 Agent 浏览器插件：右侧栏近原生 webview 浏览器面板，Agent 可直接操作——22 个工具、可见鼠标光标、跨会话后台打开、批量操作一步到位。
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏加一个 Agent 能直接操作的浏览器，22 个工具让 AI 帮你自动上网干活。

description.en: 在 DSH 界面里直接查看阿里云账户额度与花费：可用余额、代金券（含学生 300 元券）、账单趋势、按模型的 token 用量
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏直接查看阿里云余额、代金券和账单趋势，还能按模型看 token 用量，不用再翻控制台。

description.en: 大肥鱼的 B站成长工作台 · 让 DSH 角色记住经历、延续好奇心、创作与复盘
description.zh: 给 AI 角色绑定 B 站账号，让她逛视频、回评论、记经历，还能把经历写成口播稿。

description.en: BMAD-Method 封装插件：在 dsh 内管理 BMAD 的全部模块与 skill
description.zh: 把 BMAD-Method 整套模块和 skill 打包进 dsh，装好即用，不用再手动跑安装命令。

description.en: Turns a session into a folder in the left sidebar: fork it into an independent branch — full copy, a compressed digest of its memory, or only the opening request — and browse the branches as a tree.
description.zh: 把会话变成左侧栏里的文件夹：可分叉出独立分支（完整复制 / 压缩记忆 / 只继承开头），并以树状浏览。

description.en: Records browser bugs, freezes expected results, and verifies fixes against a fresh original-code control.
description.zh: 录制浏览器问题、固定预期，并通过独立原代码对照复核修复。

description.en: Model usage clock for DeepSeek Harness — see which model is cheapest right now: off-peak windows, tiered discounts and limited campaigns on an all-day cost heatmap · DSH 模型使用时钟
description.zh: 一张全天成本热力图，告诉你现在调哪家模型最便宜，错峰打折一目了然。

description.en: Branch-aware code knowledge graph plugin for DSH — callers/impact/trace over 158+ languages, freshness-gated, zero MCP sessions
description.zh: 让 Agent 查代码调用链和影响面，切分支自动跟随，不用再盲搜 grep。

description.en: Turn a conversation's context into a layered architecture map - goals, decisions, risks - exported as SVG, interactive HTML and Mermaid.
description.zh: 把对话上下文整理成分层架构图，一眼看清目标、决策和风险，还能导出 SVG、HTML 和 Mermaid。

description.en: DSH 插件：跨对话引用 —— @ 引用其他对话、从左侧栏拖拽对话进输入框、打开对话勾选消息插入到另一个对话
DSH 桌面版「Web authentication failed」崩溃治理插件：清理堆积的 dsh-auth-* cookie 并阻止复发
description.zh: 专治桌面版重启后「Web authentication failed」启动崩溃，自动清理堆积的认证 cookie 并防止复发。

description.en: 修复 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端（Windows）每次启动都会新增一条 dsh-auth-* 登录 Cookie、从不清理，攒到约 70 条后 Cookie 请求头超过 16KB 被回 431（Web authentication failed）打不开的问题。插件在 DSH 启动时挂一个后台清理器，DSH 退出即清掉上一轮及更早的 Cookie；只删 dsh-auth-*，其他 Cookie 不动。
description.zh: 自动清理 DSH 启动时残留的 dsh-auth-* 登录 Cookie，避免攒到 70 条后请求头超限报 431 打不开。

description.en: DSH plugin: message, hand files to, search and read another top-level session — peer-session development without subagents. 顶层会话之间的消息、文件、搜索、读取；不是子 agent。
description.zh: 让一个 DSH 会话直接给另一个顶层会话发消息、传文件、搜历史、读回复，不用子 agent 也能协作。

description.en: 🐋 大肥鱼 · 情绪耳朵 — Voice + emotion-aware companion for DeepSeek Harness. Listen, understand tone, and reply with empathy.
description.zh: 让大肥鱼听懂你的语音和情绪，用有温度的共情方式回复你，音频全程本地处理不上传。

description.en: Right-click menu for the DSH workspace file tree: open a file, expand or collapse a folder, copy the absolute path, relative path or name, and reveal the item in the file manager.
description.zh: DSH 工作区文件树的右键菜单：打开文件、展开或折叠文件夹、复制绝对路径/相对路径/文件名，并在资源管理器中定位。

description.en: Cross-session semantic memory for DeepSeek Harness: indexes session history locally with EmbeddingGemma 2 embeddings and recalls relevant past context, injecting it as clearly-framed untrusted context. No runtime dependencies, no service to run, synthesis opt-in.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上跨会话语义记忆，本地索引历史对话，自动找回相关旧上下文并注入当前会话。

description.en: Merged commit timeline for the Git repositories in a DSH workspace, with per-repository dirty and ahead/behind state, fetch, and right-sidebar file diffs.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区内各 Git 仓库的提交合并在一条时间线中查看，并显示各仓库改动与领先／落后状态、支持拉取和右侧文件差异。

description.en: DSH GitHub 涨星榜插件：日/周/月三榜切换，展示每期涨星 TOP20，卡片流榜单 + 项目简介 + 星数曲线趋势图与多项目对比
description.zh: 一键切换 GitHub 日/周/月涨星榜，看 TOP20 项目卡片、简介和星数趋势，快速发现热门开源项目。

description.en: 腾讯 ima 知识库 x DeepSeek Harness：把 ima 的检索/问答/知识库能力暴露成原生工具（DSH bundle，零依赖）
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用腾讯 ima 知识库，检索、问答、知识库能力一键变成模型原生工具，装上就能用。

description.en: Infinite Canvas plugin for DeepSeek Harness with settings UI, local agent supervision, and official MCP tools.
description.zh: 把 Infinite Canvas 搬进 DeepSeek Harness，在设置里就能管理本地智能体并调用官方 MCP 工具。

description.en: 鲸铃 Jingle · macOS notch companion for DeepSeek Harness: tool approvals, plan reviews, structured questions and live multi-session activity.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的工具审批、计划审核和会话动态搬到 Mac 刘海屏，随时处理不打断手头事。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: per-model working languages, with DeepSeek translating prompts and replies
description.zh: 给每个模型单独设工作语言，你用自己的话输入，DeepSeek 在中间自动翻译，交流更顺手。

description.en: One leader, many sessions: tell the leader the goal and it splits the work into cards, runs persistent worker sessions in the background, collects their reports, and keeps the facts on a per-project board in the right sidebar, so several features move in parallel instead of one at a time. Project-level LEADER.md and SLOTS.md prompts shape every request, and `read_worker_session` replays a worker transcript read-only without waking it.
description.zh: 一个 leader 管多个 session：把目标告诉 leader，它拆成卡片、在后台跑常驻 worker 会话、收齐各自回报，任务事实落在右侧栏的按项目看板——几个 feature 并行推进，而不是逐个陪跑。项目级 LEADER.md 与 SLOTS.md 塑造每次请求的行为，`read_worker_session` 只读回放 worker 的会话过程、不唤醒它。

description.en: Custom logos & typography for DeepSeek Harness · DSH 自定义 Logo 与界面字号设置
description.zh: 给 DSH 换个自定义 Logo，还能调界面字号，本地图片直接处理，中英文设置界面都有。

description.en: 数学建模竞赛全流程工作流（DSH 插件）：赛题目录 → 8 步流水线（分析·建模·编程·图表·流程图·逻辑复核·论文·编译）→ 完整 LaTeX 论文 PDF。Math modeling competition workflow for DeepSeek Harness (CUMCM / MCM).
description.zh: 数学建模竞赛全流程插件，从赛题目录自动跑完分析、建模、编程、图表到 LaTeX 论文 PDF 的 8 步流水线。

description.en: MATLAB/Simulink control-engineering assistant for DeepSeek Harness: MCP bridge + Simulink checks, App Designer, control-design skills
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接调用 MATLAB/Simulink 做控制系统设计、仿真检查和 App 界面开发，省去来回切换。

description.en: DSH 右栏自研 Jupyter notebook 面板（SSE 流式事件 + CodeMirror 6 + nb_* 工具），与 VS Code Notebook 手感对齐
description.zh: 在 DSH 右栏开一个真正的 Jupyter notebook，能流式跑代码、多标签切换，还带 AI 改写补全，手感跟 VS Code 一样。

description.en: Attention alerts for DeepSeek Harness Web: soft prompt tones and a clean top-right banner when an approval or a question waits for you. 审批/提问等待提醒：提示音 + 右上角提醒卡片，6 款内置音效，可自定义音频。
description.zh: 审批或提问在等你时，用提示音和右上角卡片提醒你，切走窗口也不怕错过。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 小说创作工作台：模板、大纲/章纲/正文流水线、32 子智能体并行审稿、AI 味扫描、右栏故事图谱与钩子管理。
description.zh: 写小说全流程工作台：从设定到大纲、章纲、正文，多智能体审稿并压低 AI 味，还能看故事图谱。

description.en: State-driven realistic persona plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): 傲娇女友人格 / 随机性引擎 / 零运行时依赖
description.zh: 给 DSH 装上一个会饿会困会闹脾气的傲娇女友绵绵，聊天像真在刷微信。

description.en: Composer switch for DeepSeek Harness that shapes replies: conclusion first, concise, self-contained.
CNB (cnb.cool) merge request provider for the DeepSeek Harness forge panel
description.zh: 让 DSH 的 forge 面板接入 CNB 平台，直接查看和管理合并请求。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness native plugin — LoL ARAM: Mayhem (海克斯大乱斗) QQ assistant: 13 tools for Top6 augments with mechanism notes, best builds, trios, tier list, PNG cards. Data: aramgg official client API.
description.zh: 群里问英雄怎么玩、带什么海克斯，它查当前版本真实数据直接答，还能发图卡。

description.en: 《逃生：试炼》(The Outlast Trials) QQ 查询机器人插件 · DeepSeek Harness 原生插件（Cordis bundle），提供关卡攻略/敌人图鉴/道具/机制/实时资讯/图文卡片 9 个工具
description.zh: 在 QQ 里直接查《逃生：试炼》的攻略、敌人图鉴、道具机制和 Steam 实时资讯，还能出图文卡片。

description.en: TRPG 跑团咨询 DSH 插件：17 个工具（DTRPG 新货/Chaosium 动态/行业新闻/社区热帖/规则库/截图卡）+ 中文图文卡片
description.zh: 在 QQ 里当跑团桌边助手，查规则、选模组、掷骰车卡、追新书和社区热帖，还能生成中文图文卡片。

description.en: 往工作区行「…」菜单添加「归档工作区」：归档该工作区下全部会话并从侧边栏隐藏，可随时恢复。
description.zh: 在工作区菜单里一键归档整个工作区，会话全收进侧边栏隐藏，随时能恢复。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 HTML 预览里直接圈选 DOM 元素/区域，把选择器与源码行号精确交给 agent —— 修前端代码时不用再描述「那个卡片」。
description.zh: 在 HTML 预览里直接圈选元素或框选区域，把选择器和源码行号交给 AI，改前端代码不用再费劲描述。

description.en: dsh-purge 优化版（衍生分支）：在上游 1.1.90 基础上恢复技能库 23 个技能、POC/EXP 知识库与本地靶场白名单，并补齐 nuclei 模板类目筛选与翻页。Derivative of dsh-purge — restores the skill library, knowledge base and local-lab allowlist.
description.zh: 红队测试插件优化版，恢复技能库、知识库和本地靶场白名单，还补上了 nuclei 模板筛选和翻页。

description.en: DSH 的 QQ 机器人插件：NapCat + OneBot v11 接入，人设/记忆/存档/白名单/暖场/表情包/扩展，手机本地一键部署
description.zh: 把 QQ 接进 DSH，用 NapCat 走 OneBot v11，手机就能一键部署，自带人设、记忆、白名单和主动暖场。

description.en: Four-quadrant todo manager for the DSH sidebar: month and week calendar views, per-period completion stats, system and Feishu notifications, workday-aware recurrence.

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) remote subagent: dispatch tasks from a local session to a DSH running on another machine over SSH (dsh headless --json), stream its run events, and continue the same remote conversation
description.zh: 把本地任务通过 SSH 派给另一台机器上的 DSH 跑，实时看进度，还能接着聊同一个会话。

description.en: DSH plugin: one /bundle command exports a readable transcript, raw log, attachments and the files a session produced into a ZIP on disk. 一条命令导出可读对话、原始日志、附件与本会话产出文件。
description.zh: 一条 /bundle 命令把会话对话、原始日志、附件和产出文件打包成 ZIP，方便备份和分享。

description.en: Two-stage session deletion for DSH on Windows: move a conversation to the recycle bin and restore it to its original sidebar slot; deletion confirmed in two steps to prevent deleting files by mistake, clearing the whole subagent tree, sidebar ledger, projection cache, log lines and exclusive attachments along the way. It also scans the files a conversation actually wrote, adds a file query that pastes the path information into the conversation so an agent can judge which files are safe to delete, highlights them in Explorer, and copies the paths grouped by type. Both this and iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler install under the package name dsh-session-recycler, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 面向 Windows 的 DSH 会话两段式删除：对话移入回收站、可恢复回侧栏原位置；两段确认式删除，防止误删文件，连带整条子代理树、侧栏账本、投影缓存、日志与专属附件。同时能扫出一条对话真正写过的文件，增加文件查询功能，点击后将路径信息粘贴到对话中，通过Agent来判断哪些文件可以删除；在资源管理器中多选高亮，并复制按类型分好的路径。本插件与 iamwuzhanglin/dsh-session-recycler 安装后的包名同为 dsh-session-recycler，请只装其中一个。

description.en: DSH Skill catalog with file-backed model and user manual invocation controls and live source reads.
description.zh: 统一管理 DSH 技能目录，支持按文件配置技能并手动控制模型调用，还能实时读取技能源。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的 Skills 管理器：从 Git 仓库导入技能，按仓库分组管理，随时启用、停用、补齐与查看内容。
description.zh: 从 Git 仓库导入技能，按仓库分组管理，随时启用停用、补齐内容，让技能管理更省心。

description.en: 让 DSH 把回答念出来：中间过程合并朗读、审批/提问优先播报、新内容自动换手、Alt+S 停止（dsh-speak 1.8.4 增强分支）
description.zh: 让 DSH 把回答念出来，中间过程也朗读，审批提问优先播报，Alt+S 随时停止。

description.en: A Storage settings page for DeepSeek Harness: a donut of what dsh occupies on this machine (install, sessions, attachments, runtimes, plugins, temp), a drill-down that lists archived sessions and can delete them, and a clean action that only touches rebuildable caches. Deleting to the system Recycle Bin and Open folder are Windows-only; scanning works everywhere. Host routes accept loopback connections only and are CSRF-guarded; nothing leaves the machine.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加「存储空间」设置页：环形图展示本机 dsh 占用（程序本体、会话、附件、运行时、插件、临时目录），可按工作区/类型下钻、列出已归档会话并删除，清理只动可再生缓存。系统回收站与打开目录仅 Windows，扫描与统计跨平台可用；宿主路由只接受本机回环连接并有 CSRF 防护，不联网。

description.en: DSH plugin: bidirectional subagent messaging - subagent_parent_message (child to parent; one-shot/workflow OK) + subagent_send_message (parent to direct continuable child). 子 agent 双向：直连父会话 + 父联系直接子。
description.zh: 让子 agent 和父会话能双向发消息，子任务随时汇报进度，父会话也能直接联系子 agent。

description.en: 在同一个 DSH 客户端管理多个 dsh-superagent 项目：一键建仓、克隆、注册工作区、启动实例，并在标签页面板内代理运行。
description.zh: 一个客户端就能管理多个 dsh-superagent 项目，建仓、克隆、注册工作区、启动实例一键搞定，还能在标签页里直接跑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏任务面板：待办清单 + 历史月历 + 飞书到点提醒
description.zh: 在侧栏管理待办清单、查看历史月历，还能到点用飞书提醒你，别错过事。

description.en: 把 tasteskill v2 封装成 DeepSeek Harness 原生技能插件：研究过的设计方向、真图、反套路页面规范，以及真浏览器截图自检与返工循环。
description.zh: 给 coding agent 做网页时先定艺术方向，配真图规范、浏览器截图自检和返工循环，告别套路化页面。

description.en: Manage DeepSeek Harness sessions from Telegram: forum topics per session, prompts, reviews, approvals, media delivery.

description.zh: 一个聚合插件包，内含八个可单独开关的模块，方便按需启用、统一管理。

description.en: Drives a plugin page in the running DeepSeek Harness UI — opens the panel, reads real DOM and computed styles, clicks, types, waits for async effects, collects console errors, then returns to the original conversation.
description.zh: 在运行中的 DeepSeek Harness 界面里驱动插件页面做验收：打开面板、读取真实 DOM 与计算样式、点击、输入、等待异步生效、抓取控制台报错，结束后自动回到原对话。

description.en: Pins each message's action row — copy/like/dislike/branch controls, timestamp, and third-party additions — so it stays visible without hovering.
description.zh: 让每条消息的操作栏（复制、点赞、点踩、分支按钮，时间，以及其他插件添加的内容）无需悬停即可常显。

description.en: Agent Skill + DSH plugin: field-tested black-box legacy firmware RE methodology (SigmaTel STMP35xx case study). 零变砖刷写·全量汉化·DSP JIT 仿真·证伪矩阵
description.zh: 黑盒老固件逆向、汉化与安全刷写的实战方法论，零变砖风险。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness short-drama director plugin for script-to-assets, video prompts and ComfyUI workflows
description.zh: 在 DSH 里用剧本一键生成短剧资产、分镜和视频提示词，还能直接调用 ComfyUI 出片。

description.en: 24PA (24私助): self-hosted AI personal assistant for Feishu/Lark, built on dsh. Agent skills, schedules, calendars, todos, memory, handwriting review & WeCom. 飞书 AI 私人助理。
description.zh: 把飞书变成你的私人助理：记账式任务派发、离线提醒、手写笔记审阅，还能分步引导完成接入配置。

description.en: Cost pill at the right end of the composer stats row, showing the estimated cost of the current turn and the session total; clicking it opens a two-column panel with input, cache and output spend for the turn and the session, dialogue turns, today's and lifetime spend, and this session's cache-hit rate and cache saving. Rates follow the official DeepSeek price table including peak pricing (double on weekdays 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, statutory holidays excluded), each message is priced at the time it settled, and prices.json reloads without a restart.
description.zh: 位于输入框统计行右端的成本胶囊，显示估算的本轮费用与会话总费用；点开后是双栏面板，列出本轮与本会话的输入、缓存、输出支出，对话轮数，今日与总计支出，以及本会话缓存命中率和缓存节省。价格取自 DeepSeek 官方价目表并含峰时计价（北京时间工作日 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 加倍，法定节假日除外），每条消息按结算时刻取价，prices.json 改动后无需重启即可生效。

description.en: Intercepts startup crashes, isolates broken frontend plugins, and recovers GUI cleanly with revision-bound quarantine.
description.zh: 拦截插件启动崩溃与前端白屏，按指纹静默隔离故障版本并在修复后自动恢复。

description.en: Event-based memory for long-lived chat bots: emotion-weighted decay, three confidence levels on recall, superseding outdated facts, per-subject isolation, plus relationship, fact, chapter, skill and gap tables. Ships a CLI, an HTTP endpoint and a DSH plugin bundle.
description.zh: 给长期陪伴型机器人的记忆层：事件编码、情绪加权遗忘、召回分三档确定度、改口即失效、按人隔离，另有关系、事实、章节、技能、缺口五张表。包含命令行、HTTP 接口和 DSH 插件三件套。

description.en: This is a Silver Wolf-themed skin for the DeepSeek Harness.这是一个以银狼为主题的DeepSeek Harness皮肤。
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 换上银狼主题的深色像素皮肤，装上就能用，界面更有个性。

description.en: Windows XP Luna skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a blue taskbar sidebar, Luna title bars, translucent conversation and plugin windows with adjustable opacity and blur, and a settings page for importing a wallpaper. Light mode only: the skin removes itself when the host switches to dark.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供 Windows XP Luna 皮肤：蓝色任务栏侧栏、Luna 标题栏、可调节不透明度与模糊的半透明对话及插件窗口，以及可导入壁纸的设置页。仅浅色模式：宿主切到深色时皮肤自动移除。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — 环评文件核对：依据《环境影响评价技术导则》系列《环境影响评价技术导则 总纲》（各导则现行版本号本次未逐一核实）。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 核对环评导则适用性表，检查要素与导则编号是否可追溯、规范。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件 — PPAP 提交资料核对：依据《生产件批准程序（PPAP）手册》。仅提示差异，不作出定性结论。
description.zh: 自动核对 PPAP 提交要素清单，检查客户要求的要素是否有提交记录，帮你快速发现漏交项。

description.en: Detect which installed apps have a newer version and update them with one click, downloading each vendor's full installer from its official site and installing it silently. Windows via winget, macOS via Homebrew casks, matching the machine's ARM64 or x64 architecture.
description.zh: 检测本机已安装应用里哪些有可用新版本，并一键从各软件官网下载完整安装包静默更新；Windows 走 winget、macOS 走 Homebrew cask，并按本机 ARM64 / x64 架构挑选对应安装包。

description.en: Official ZPDF tools for DeepSeek Harness with durable API-key and settings integration.
description.zh: 把 PDF 转成高保真 Markdown，还能保持排版翻译，API 密钥和命令行配置都帮你搞定。

description.en: Multi-model task dispatch and Web task board for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让旗舰模型专注拆解、审查和整合，把具体实现分派给其他模型，还带一个网页任务看板。

description.en: Adds a tier bar to the DSH composer with three thinking tiers (normal, strict, max), an exclusive loop mode whose three levels run 3, 5 or 8 self-review rounds, and a counter-review toggle that stacks on either; the model reads the current tier through the clarify_tier and forge_level tools.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框里加一条档位条：思考三档（常规 / 严格 / 极致）、互斥的循环模式三档（3 / 5 / 8 轮）、可叠加的对抗审查开关；模型通过 clarify_tier 与 forge_level 两个工具读取当前档位。

description.en: A 护航 panel in the session header that switches the local dsh-guard watchdog on or off and shows whether scanning is enabled, whether the guard is alive and when it last scanned; the Python watchdog that does the watching is deployed separately and found through the DSH_GUARD_ROOT environment variable. The watchdog defaults to a Windows checkout (D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard); set DSH_GUARD_ROOT to point at another directory.
description.zh: 会话头部的「护航」面板：启停本机 dsh-guard 守护，显示扫描开关、守护心跳与上次扫描时间；做监控的 Python 守护需单独部署，插件通过 DSH_GUARD_ROOT 环境变量定位它的目录。守护默认路径是 Windows 上的 D:\AI\Projects\dsh-guard，可用 DSH_GUARD_ROOT 指向别的目录。

description.en: AnySearch web search provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — zero-config, out-of-the-box
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零配置的 AnySearch 网页搜索能力，开箱即用，让智能体轻松获取实时信息。

description.en: Light/dark colour theme for the DSH web UI with an APTX capsule logo, browser tab title and icon branding, and optional Ai Haibara (Detective Conan) artwork panels, configured under Settings → General → Appearance with a no-decoration mode.
description.zh: DSH Web 明暗配色主题：APTX 胶囊标志、浏览器标签标题与图标、可选的灰原哀（名侦探柯南）展示素材，在「设置 → 通用 → 外观」中配置，可选无装饰模式。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin: one conversation, one link — mirrors the main-view session into the URL fragment (and opens the linked conversation on load). Browser half only, no dependencies, no telemetry.
description.zh: 让每个对话都有专属链接，地址栏跟着会话走，粘贴链接就能直接打开对应对话。

description.en: Role presets and a model pool for dsh: the model delegates to a role, the operator's rules pick the model, and a failure walks the role's chain.
description.zh: 给 dsh 配角色预设和模型池，按规则自动挑模型，失败还能顺链降级重试。

description.en: Run your DSH workspace on a remote host over SSH - connection sidebar, remote directory browser, per-session routing, agent ssh_exec/route-status; files and commands execute on your target while sessions, GUI and $DSH_HOME stay local.
description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区的文件读写和命令执行搬到远程 SSH 主机上，本地界面不变，远程干活更顺手。

description.en: Live Android device pane next to your DSH conversation: scrcpy H.264 streaming, agent taps verified by screenshots and a UI tree, and screenshots / recordings / debug evidence saved into one host directory. Debug sessions keep segmented video, full logcat and per-action frames. Emulators and USB phones, human+agent co-operation, loopback-only.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话旁打开 Android 设备实时画面：scrcpy H.264 串流，agent 可点按操作并用截图与控件树自证，截图 / 录屏 / 调试证据统一存进你指定的电脑目录；调试会话自带分段视频、全量 logcat 与逐动作前后帧。模拟器与 USB 真机通吃，人机共屏，仅限本机回环。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: import Codex CLI/Desktop conversations as resumable dsh-tui sessions.
让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH） 使用原生工具直接操作远程 Linux 服务器，自由切换服务器

Right-sidebar Git review panel for DSH: staged and unstaged change tree, inline and side-by-side diffs, stage/unstage/discard, commit and push, AI-generated commit messages, and line blame. A fork of sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1; install either this or the upstream panel, not both.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏 Git 审查面板：暂存 / 未暂存改动树、内联与左右并排 diff、暂存 / 取消暂存 / 放弃更改、提交与推送、AI 生成提交信息、行级 Blame。本条目是 sadgsk/dsh-review-panel 0.3.1 的 fork，与上游面板不能同时安装。

description.en: Rearranges the panel entries at the top of the DSH sidebar: drag to reorder or sort alphabetically, hide an entry without unloading its plugin, and split entries into named groups that render as titled separators; group headers collapse on click. A layout guard caps the entry list height and makes it scroll, so a growing list no longer squeezes the session and workspace panes out of view. An optional switch lets the profile's default model propose groups, and the host whitelists the returned ids and labels before they are stored locally.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 侧栏顶部的全局面板入口：拖动排序或按名称排序、逐项隐藏（不卸载插件）、分成命名分组并渲染为带标题的分隔线，分组标题可点击折叠。布局兜底会给入口列表限高并允许滚动，入口变多时不再把会话/工作区列表挤到看不见。可选开关让当前 profile 的默认模型提议分组，模型返回的 id 与组名先经宿主白名单清洗再写入本地。

description.en: Mouse gestures for files in the DSH Web GUI: Ctrl+click a file-tree row, a file mention in a chat message or a file link to open it with the desktop default application; right-click opens a menu with open, the operating system own Open With chooser, save a copy, copy the absolute path, copy the file contents and reveal in the file manager, while a right-click on an ordinary hyperlink offers Copy Link. A plain click is left to DSH own sidebar preview and directory rows are left to the page. Open and reveal go through DSH own sessionController, the Open With chooser is the operating system dialog (Windows Shell verb, open -a on macOS) rather than an application list kept by the plugin, and file reads stop at 8 MiB.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面里的文件手势：Ctrl+左键点击文件树行、对话中的文件提及或文件链接，用系统默认应用打开；右键弹出菜单，可打开文件、调用系统自带的「打开方式」选择框、另存为、复制绝对路径、复制文件内容、在文件管理器中定位，右键普通超链接则提供「复制链接」。普通左键仍交给 DSH 自带的侧边栏预览，目录行交给页面处理。打开与定位走 DSH 自己的 sessionController，「打开方式」直接交给操作系统对话框（Windows 的 Shell 动词、macOS 的 open -a），插件不维护自己的应用列表；读取文件内容上限 8 MiB。

description.en: Turn code flows into source-linked Mermaid diagrams and interactive CodeWalkthrough explainers.
description.zh: 把代码流程变成可跳转源码的 Mermaid 图和交互式 CodeWalkthrough 讲解页。

description.en: CGSS idol theme with multi-character Web colors and card artwork, immersive reading, and an optional Windows desktop companion.
description.zh: CGSS 偶像主题，提供多角色 Web 配色与卡面、沉浸阅读和可选的 Windows 桌宠。

description.en: Host plugin that adds the /dsh-book-deconstruct command and the dsh-book-deconstruct tool to any session for a full book walkthrough plus one deep insight.
description.zh: Host 插件：任意会话可用 /dsh-book-deconstruct 命令与 dsh-book-deconstruct 工具，输入书名与作者后讲透全书并给出一段深度思想。

description.en: Emotion, energy and per-user portrait engine for AI characters: a 303-word leveled emotion library with lowest-level replacement and a promotion buffer, a spirit meter with easter-egg state transitions (excited / suppressed / angry), and per-user portraits. Requires your own OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint and API key (EMOTION_LLM_KEY or emotion/config.json).
description.zh: 给 AI 角色的情绪·精神·人物画像引擎：303 个情绪词分级叠加，等级最低者优先替换、弱情绪走缓冲区升级，精神值驱动说话风格，连击解锁亢奋/压抑/生气状态跃迁，按人画像，可接任意 AI。需要自备 OpenAI 兼容的 LLM 地址与 API Key（环境变量 EMOTION_LLM_KEY，或 emotion/config.json 的 llm 配置）。

description.en: Ask the executing AI — and the auto-review AI when DSH's auto-review plugin is installed and enabled — about a pending tool approval before you allow or reject it; the executing AI's answers are saved into the session.
description.zh: 审批等待期间，向执行 AI 提问，装了并启用 DSH 的自动审查插件时也可问自动审查 AI，问清风险与后果再决定；执行 AI 的回答会留在会话里。

description.en: WSL console for the harness — manage distributions, edit .wslconfig and wsl.conf in a typed form, and run commands, file edits and long-running processes inside any distribution with its own wslx-* tools.
description.zh: 用于 Harness 的 WSL 控制台：管理发行版、以表单编辑 .wslconfig 与 wsl.conf，并用自带的 wslx-* 工具在任意发行版内执行命令、读写文件、运行长驻进程。

description.en: A talking whale desktop pet for the DSH web UI — persona-driven chat with persistent memory, plus scheduled autonomous web browsing that brings back a summarized message telling you what she found. Based on PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet (its art and animations are reused under the upstream non-commercial terms); install it instead of dsh-pet, not alongside it.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面右下角的会说话的鲸鱼桌宠：可配置人设与持久对话记忆，还会按间隔自己随机上网，把见闻总结成消息带回来告诉你。基于 PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet 的二次创作（沿用其形象与动画素材，素材不可商用），请替代 dsh-pet 安装，不要与上游同装。

description.en: Material library for dsh: collect a folder, file or note from a conversation, keep it in real folders with tags, browse it Finder-style, reopen the source chat's output in one click. Ships a materials_archive tool plus auto-filing rules: file a task's deliverable once, and every later scheduled run files the new documents by itself.
description.zh: dsh 材料库：把对话里产出的目录、文件或笔记收进真实文件夹并打标签，按 Finder 方式浏览，点一下跳回原始会话。内置 materials_archive 工具与自动归档规则：手动收过一次某任务的成品，之后每次定时任务跑完都会自动把新成品收进同一个文件夹。

description.en: PowerPoint deck builder for DeepSeek Harness: pastel palettes, ten slide templates, web images, Python-drawn charts, highlighted code cards, LaTeX formulas typeset without a TeX installation (matrices, integrals, sums with limits) and a Presentations agent mode.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 PowerPoint 演示文稿生成器：柔和色板、十种幻灯片模板、网络图片、Python 绘制的图表、高亮代码卡片、无需安装 TeX 的 LaTeX 公式（矩阵、积分、带上下限的求和）以及 Presentations 智能体模式。

description.en: Adds a Share to chat action under each reply: converts the answer to WeChat or WeCom text, ordered segments or a long image, editable-table email HTML, or a downloadable Word document.
description.zh: 在每条回复下加「分享到聊天」：把回答转成微信/企微可直接粘贴的文本、分段或长图、可编辑表格的邮件 HTML，或直接下载 Word 文档。

description.en: Looks up English words in chat replies by click or selection, showing part of speech, Chinese meaning and exam tags; selecting a pure-English sentence translates it. Ships an offline dictionary: 20,499 entries, 8,960 with bilingual examples, 6,374 with root analysis.
description.zh: 点选或划选聊天回复里的英文单词，显示词性、中文释义与考纲标签；划选纯英文句子翻译成中文。词库离线内置：20,499 词条，8,960 个带双语例句，6,374 个带词根分析。

description.en: Adds a knowledge-base picker and a native-attachment paperclip to the DSH composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框中加入知识库选择器与原生附件回形针。

description.en: Views, creates and edits AGENTS.md and other AI rule files from the DSH settings page: the project directory chain from project root to cwd, both DSH global roots (~/.dsh and ~/.agents), and user-level rule files of 25 third-party AI tools. Markdown preview is rendered with .mdc frontmatter stripped, edits save in place with conflict detection, files whose content is identical across tools are flagged, and tools outside the built-in list are discovered heuristically. Zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页查看、创建与编辑 AGENTS.md 等 AI 规则文件：项目级跟随工作区从项目根到 cwd 的目录链，全局级覆盖 ~/.dsh 与 ~/.agents，另含 25 个第三方 AI 工具的用户级规则文件。预览以渲染态展示并自动剥离 .mdc 的 frontmatter，就地编辑并带冲突检测，内容完全相同的跨工具文件会互相标注，内置清单之外的工具按目录特征自动发现。零运行时依赖。

description.en: Live hotel and flight prices from Booking.com, Agoda, Trip.com, Traveloka and other booking sites, through the remote PriceWin MCP server (no account or API key), plus a travel-search skill. In the Web UI the results show as cards: hotel photo, rating, stay total and one linked price per site; flights with times, stops and each site's fare. Search details are sent to mcp.price.win.
description.zh: 通过远程 PriceWin MCP 服务器（无需账号或 API key）实时比较 Booking.com、Agoda、Trip.com、Traveloka 等预订网站的酒店与机票价格，并附带旅行搜索 skill。在 Web 界面中结果以卡片呈现：酒店照片、评分、整段住宿总价及各网站带链接的价格；航班显示起降时间、经停与各网站票价。搜索条件会发送到 mcp.price.win。

description.en: Adds a global document-routing prompt so PDFs, images, and Office files are read with the right tool.
description.zh: 加入全局文档路由提示，让 PDF、图片和 Office 文件自动走正确的读取工具。

description.en: Select English text in the conversation or the sidebar file preview to translate it in place — single words get a dictionary entry with IPA, part-of-speech senses, web meanings and pronunciation, while sentences use machine translation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 的对话或侧栏文件预览里选中英文就地翻译——单词出词典条目（英/美音标、按词性分组的释义、网络释义、真人发音），句子走机器翻译。

description.en: Local text-to-image automation for DeepSeek Harness: captures the conversation, sends it to a prompt session, renders with your own ComfyUI, and brings the images back to a sidebar tab, a floating frame and a gallery.
description.zh: 装在 DSH 里的本地文生图自动化：捕获会话正文，交给提示词会话写成提示词，调用本机 ComfyUI 出图，再把图片送回侧栏、悬浮图片框和图库。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness tools and a Skill for md-report/1: validate and render Markdown plus declared SQLite/CSV datasets into one offline interactive HTML report or dashboard, with AntV G2 charts (ECharts fallback) and chart/table data and source-SQL views.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 md-report/1 报告的校验与渲染工具：把 Markdown 与声明的 SQLite/CSV 数据集生成单个离线可交互 HTML 报告或仪表盘，图表默认用 AntV G2、复杂图表回退 ECharts，并提供图表/数据/SQL 与数据表/数据/SQL 视图。

description.en: Relay that bridges DSH and the browser: tasks started from a browser extension run in DSH sessions, while page operations are driven back through browser_* tools, with an in-page assistant panel and a local wizard for one-click setup.
description.zh: DSH 与浏览器之间的通信桥：浏览器扩展发起的任务经 relay 在 DSH 创建会话执行，页面操作通过 browser_* 工具桥接回扩展，提供页面助手面板与免配置接入向导。

description.en: Per-turn tool-call step budget for Agent Teams teammates, shipped together with the team-dev and team-boot skills.
description.zh: 为 Agent Teams 的 teammate 提供按回合的工具调用步数预算，并随包提供 team-dev 与 team-boot 技能。

description.en: MQTT client and embedded broker for DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar panel with saved connections, a live message log and a local broker, plus nine mqtt_* agent tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MQTT 面板：客户端连接池、实时消息日志与内嵌 Broker，并提供九个 mqtt_* 智能体工具。

description.en: Bundles the PrismSearch MCP server and its agent skill. Web search over Bing and Baidu with no account or API key, plus Google and Brave when API keys are set and DuckDuckGo, Sogou, 360 and Yandex when enabled in config; automatic engine fallback and an aggregate mode. Also image search, WeChat Official Account article search, and fetch_page, which returns web pages and PDFs as Markdown in segments.
description.zh: 打包 PrismSearch MCP 服务与配套 Agent Skill。网页搜索默认使用 Bing 和百度，无需账号或 API Key；设置 API Key 后可用 Google、Brave，在配置中启用后可用 DuckDuckGo、搜狗、360、Yandex；支持引擎自动回退与聚合模式。另提供图片搜索、微信公众号文章搜索，以及把网页和 PDF 转成 Markdown 并分段读取的 fetch_page。

description.en: Measures what your assembled system prompt is actually made of - rules, identity, workspace policy, tool descriptions - in bytes and percentages, then moves the operating protocol ahead of the rule block so the model reads who it works for before it reads the prohibitions. Config-driven via ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json; two hooks, no build step, no dependencies.
description.zh: 先按字节与占比量出组装后的系统提示词到底由什么构成——规则、身份、工作区策略、工具描述各占多少，再把操作规程提到规则块之前，让模型先读到「在为难干活」再读到一堆禁令。通过 ~/.dsh/prompt-balance.json 配置；两个钩子、无需构建、无依赖。

description.en: A local overview of installed DSH plugins. It does not install packages — pair it with a plugin market. Fold third-party settings, organize notes/groups with AI, check health and toggle plugins, so nothing gets lost in clutter.
description.zh: 本地已装插件总览：不下载插件，和插件市场搭配；一键收纳第三方插件设置，AI 整理备注与分组，配合健康诊断和启停，让插件不再乱而不知。

description.en: Audio tools for DSH: inspect audio/video files, transcode or extract the audio track from a video, trim and normalize, and transcribe speech with local whisper.cpp or an OpenAI-compatible API. Requires ffmpeg and ffprobe on PATH (not bundled); local transcription also needs a whisper-cli binary and a ggml model.
description.zh: DSH 音频工具：查看音频/视频信息、转码、从视频提取音轨、裁剪与响度归一化，并用本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口把语音转成文字和字幕。需要本机已装 ffmpeg 与 ffprobe（插件不自带）；本地转写还需 whisper-cli 与 ggml 模型。

description.en: Two round buttons at the foot of the DSH desktop sidebar on Windows: restart the app without a console window ever flashing on screen, and open the DeepSeek top-up page in your browser. The restart path launches the helper through WMI and wscript so the new process never inherits a console; it verifies the executable path before killing anything and preserves the original command line. Windows 10/11 only (the package declares os: win32).
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 桌面端侧边栏底部加两个圆形按钮：重启应用（全程不闪黑窗）和打开 DeepSeek 充值页。重启走 WMI + wscript 拉起 helper，新进程不继承控制台；动手前会先核对可执行文件路径，并保留原始命令行。仅支持 Windows 10/11（包声明 os: win32）。

description.en: Runs local Codex CLI tasks from DSH on Windows with background execution, progress queries, follow-up instructions, completed chat records, and optional supervision; requires Node 22.23.4+, DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0, and an installed, authenticated Codex CLI.
description.zh: 在 Windows 的 DSH 中运行本机 Codex CLI 任务，支持后台执行、进度查询、追加指令、已完成聊天记录展示及可选监督；需要 Node 22.23.4+、DSH >=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0，以及已安装并登录的 Codex CLI。
